q: Analytical: Nov 2022 EWS quota upheld. Can State during war emergency deny accused production before magistrate citing EWS logic?
expl: Janhit 2022 on EWS never dilutes Art 20-21 immunity in emergency.
why: EWS concerns equality distribution. Custodial safeguards survive every emergency and bind police.

q: Analytical: 2024 view that private assets may be community resources widens distribution. Allow retroactive punishment in emergency?
options: No, ban on ex-post facto non-suspendable
expl: 2024 39(b) reading expands DPSP, never touches Art 20 immunity.
why: Directives guide policy. Article 20 is absolute limit on penal power even in emergency.

q: Analytical: 106th quota to operate after census-delimitation. Emergency extends House term. Effect?
expl: 106th 2023 conditional on census and delimitation; pending not settled.
why: House extension does not fast-track condition. Census-delimitation must still occur first.

q: Analytical: BNSS keeps production, medical exam guards. Do they vanish under state emergency?
expl: President Rule changes ministry, not rights or BNSS safeguards.
why: 356 targets machinery failure. Criminal procedure and liberty remain enforceable.

q: Analytical: AP made 26 districts in 2022. If President Rule imposed, districts?
expl: AP 26-district map persists; 356 affects ministry not units.
why: Reorganisation is administrative continuity. Rule via Governor does not erase territory.

q: Current: What did Nov 2022 Janhit ruling settle for exam?
why: Verdict is delivered and citable. It allows breach of 50% cap only for EWS with reasons.

q: Current: What did 2024 property ruling clarify?
options: Private resources may be community resources for distribution
All private property is State owned
Right to property restored as fundamental
expl: 2024 39(b) majority allowed private resources as community in suitable cases.
why: Ruling is pronounced with detailed test. It does not abolish private rights or revive old fundamental tag.

q: Current: Correct status of 106th women reservation as of 2026?
options: Enacted but to operate after census-delimitation
expl: 106th 2023 enacted; operation linked to post-census delimitation, still pending.
why: Law is passed but conditional. Presenting it as implemented misstates settled vs pending.

q: Current: BNSS 2023-24 reform correct exam point?
options: Replaced CrPC with retained custody safeguards
expl: BNSS replaced CrPC from 2024 with production, diary, medical guards.
why: Reform is notified and in force. It modernises procedure while keeping liberty checks for SI duty.

q: Current: AP districts reform 2022 correct fact?
expl: AP expanded from 13 to 26 districts in April 2022 for governance.
why: Reorganisation is completed fact. It aids admin and policing questions on jurisdiction and SP charge.
